note: Local-machine default only. CI (CI=true) ignores this file and always runs its full matrix -- this exists purely to keep a developer/agent machine from spinning up Docker/Postgres/MySQL/MinIO by default. Raise checkLevel or add postgres/mysql/minio to enabledEngines to opt back in for a specific task. Read by scripts/quality/test_profile.py; consumed by NPDevKernel PostgresTestSupport.java (via NPDEV_TEST_PROFILE_ENGINES), NPDevKernel/adapters/file-store-objectstore's S3ObjectStoreFileStoreAdapterMinioLiveTest.java (same env var, its own local minioEnabled() -- RUN-31 item 2), and scripts/proofs/run-item20-postgres-proof.ps1 / scripts/quality/run-docker-linux-proof.ps1 (via docker_allowed()).
